Certainly! Here are two hints for the given step:

**Hint 1:** Consider the definition of the mean absolute error (MAE). It is the average of the absolute differences between the predicted values and the actual values. Think about how the choice of $$	heta_0$$ affects these differences.

**Hint 2:** Recall that the MAE is minimized when the predicted value is the median of the actual values. This is because the median minimizes the sum of absolute deviations. Consider how this relates to the uniqueness of $$	heta_0$$.
